block.anchor: exact absolute uint16 of the original first sample, 16 bits MSB-first
block.predictor: previous reconstructed sample; reset to the anchor at each block start

corrections.summary: aggregate byte accounting corrected to the sum of independently padded block payload lengths; the per-block ceiling formula is unchanged

counting.aggregate_stored_bytes: sum over independent blocks of the per-block stored bytes; NOT ceil(sum(valid_bit_count) / 8), which would describe one continuous bitstream
counting.inner_codec_body_bits: exact significant payload bits (16 anchor bits + chosen body bits) per block; an aggregate over blocks is their sum
counting.inner_codec_padding_bits: 8 * stored_bytes - body_bits, the summed zero padding of each block final byte
counting.inner_codec_stored_bytes: per block ceil(valid_bit_count / 8) including final-byte zero padding; an aggregate is the sum of the block payload lengths
counting.per_block_ceiling_formula: stored bytes of one block = ceil(valid_bit_count / 8); valid per block only

fixture_fields.note: candidate fixture only; not a TRACE layout field set
fixture_fields.payload_hex: payload bytes as hex; unused low bits of the final byte must be zero
fixture_fields.valid_bit_count: exact number of significant payload bits (>= 16)

name: deepeye-integer-inner-codec-candidate-rules

quantization.error_bound_observation: abs(x - y) <= E per sample in seeded tests; RAW blocks are exact
quantization.q_formula: q = (x - p + E) // D with mathematical floor division
quantization.reconstruct_formula: y = min(65535, max(0, p + q*D)); p = y

raw.anchor: the original first sample is always the anchor
raw.body: original remaining uint16 samples, 16 bits each, MSB-first
raw.property: a RAW block reproduces its input exactly (lossless bypass)

rejections: bool, non-int or out-of-range scalar samples
rice fixture without an int k, k outside 0..15, raw fixture with k not null
sample_count not an int in 1..128 (bool rejected)
valid_bit_count not an int, below the 16-bit anchor, above the payload, or leaving excess payload bytes
payload_hex not a hex string, odd length, or non-hex characters
truncated bitstream before the declared sample count
unary run longer than 31 zeroes (overlong unary)
extra valid bits remaining after the declared sample count

rice.quotient_cap_rule: quotient > 31 is illegal for that k; there is no escape code
rice.remainder: k low bits of z, MSB-first
rice.unary: quotient zero bits followed by a one terminator

scope.acceptance: none; R03 stays blocked, B01 stays not_run, A alone operates the board
scope.implementation: inner codec block body only (candidate foundation)
not_defined_here: E/k signalling in the outer format

selection.choice: minimum encoded bit count; ties choose the lowest k
selection.granularity: one k for the whole block
selection.metric: total Rice body bits = sum(z_i >> k) + (n-1)*(k+1)
selection.no_legal_k_note: for uint16 inputs the k=15 candidate is always legal; the no-legal-k branch is reachable through the selection helper API
selection.raw_rule: RAW when no k is legal or when the best Rice body bits >= 16*(n-1); RAW wins ties

unresolved_public_fields_to_report: sparse selection point ordinal vs acquisition index
payload offset and layout version encoding
E/k signalling in the outer format
